Class Stage2Controller

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.view.gui.Stage2Controller
public class Stage2Controller extends Object
Controller for the ship assembly phase (Stage 2) of the game. Manages component selection from face-up cards or deck, placement on the ship grid, viewing opponent ships, and timer management for level 2 games. Coordinates between the main assembly view and the selected tile controller for component manipulation.
